# SetSamplerAddressModeV 〔BlitzLLVM〕

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Textures](Blitz3D-Textures)

## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
SetSamplerAddressModeV sampler:Int32, mode:Int32
```

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Chooses what is read where the vertical texture coordinate (v) is not between 0 and 1. The modes are the ones of [SetSamplerAddressModeU](SetSamplerAddressModeU): 0 repeat, 1 mirror, 2 clamp, 3 border ([SetSamplerBorderColor](SetSamplerBorderColor)). This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals read every texture with the settings of its flags and do not have samplers.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* The mode has to be 0 to 3, other values stop the program with an error.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sampler` | Int32 | required | The sampler to change. |
| `mode` | Int32 | required | The address mode, 0 to 3. |
